protocol: AA 55 | length=3 | sequence:u8 | centi-C:i16 LE | sum8

method.drop: every fifth generated frame, applied first
method.corrupt: every seventh generated frame, if retained: noise prefix and flipped checksum byte
method.delay: every sixth generated frame, if retained: delayed by 350 virtual ms
method.freshness: time since sample generation, stale at >= 300 ms
method.late_policy: decode late messages, but never overwrite a newer displayed sample
method.limits: synthetic timing and a projected 3D glyph; no device model, hardware or physiological validation
